description:
Join us in the beautiful south of Portugal for a Spring Yoga retreat. Over the course of a few days, you’ll immerse yourself in the peaceful environment and the practice of Yoga, with focus on connecting to your own experience and by that, deepening your understanding of your own unique anatomy. This retreat is an opportunity to slow down, cultivate awareness and explore the subtleties of your practice.

[More information](https://yoga.ehudneuhaus.com)
